research_question: Does adding static body-only distances to food13 improve mean greedy food score under matched 40000-step training?
hypothesis: Model B body16 has higher mean evaluation food score than Model A food13; improvement is not assumed. Secondary outcomes: median, episode length, collision, truncation and variability across independent training seeds.
primary_outcome: Mean food items per greedy evaluation episode; aggregate as the mean of three independent training-seed means.
training_seed_schedule: training_seed_starts[str(model_seed)] + zero_based_episode_index; same within A/B pair; smoke starts850000

analysis.comparison: B minus A paired by training seed
analysis.checkpoint_selection: final only; no seed or checkpoint selection

food_distance_definition: dx=(food_x-head_x)/(width-1); dy=(food_y-head_y)/(height-1); positive right/down; float32; current visible food only; no food => zero offsets.
budget_definition: Exactly 40000 interactions; episodes=40000 is an unreachable earlier safety bound since every episode requires at least one interaction. Incomplete final episode logged separately; no episode count stopping before the move cap.
seed_audit_note: Before training, existing results/configuration records showed model seeds77 and88 were used in 5D/5E smoke validation. User explicitly approved replacing requested77/88/99 with111/122/133. Model seeds111/122/133 and smoke155 are unused in prior experiments. Evaluation950000-950099 and smoke960000-960004 are unused; food blocks700000-739999,750000-789999,800000-839999 and smoke850000-850255 are disjoint from previous recorded/protocol smoke seeds.
body_distance_definition: For straight/right/left rays, count consecutive free cells before first other snake segment; tail occupied, head excluded. Divide hit distance by max(width,height)-1 (19 on20x20). No body before boundary =>1.0 fixed maximum-range sentinel, regardless of wall proximity. Walls are not body. Float32[0,1]; static snapshot, not future safety.
